title: WoDX Interactables
description: World of Darkness Expanded: doors, locks, windows and walls that can be broken through, on core Foundry walls. A player selects a token and presses Interact (token HUD or the I key) to see everything within reach, with the roll, the difficulty, the time and the noise shown before rolling. Results apply at once with an Undo for the Storyteller; only a wall knocked through waits in the approval queue. NPCs in earshot hear loud attempts. Each state can have its own tile picture (or a marker), with a sound and a floating word for every player who can see or hear it; every change is passed on as a map event for NPCs and the Storyteller. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
